environment.description: Service deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with no request validation. The ALB forwards all POST requests to /v1/oauth/callback directly to the container. IMDSv1 is available (task role has broad permissions). No network egress restrictions on the task. The container runs with the default Fargate networking which allows access to the link-local metadata endpoint at 169.254.169.254.

config.load_balancer: ALB with default listener rules (path-based routing only)
config.network_policy: default VPC security group, all egress allowed
